title: CodeComfy Preset
description: User-authored ComfyUI workflow preset for codecomfy-vscode.

id.description: Unique preset identifier. Letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens only.

name.description: Human-readable preset name shown in the QuickPick.

description.description: Optional description rendered in QuickPick labels and gallery detail views.

kind.description: Generation kind. Determines which command surfaces the preset.

defaults.description: Default input values (width, height, steps, cfg_scale, fps for video, etc).

workflow.description: ComfyUI workflow JSON (node-id -> node object mapping). Each node has class_type + inputs.
